prompts.title: Plan a local task
prompts.description: Create a bounded plan that does not run actions automatically.
prompts.prompt: Plan this task using local resources only: {{task}}. List assumptions, steps, and checks. Do not execute actions; identify anything requiring approval.

prompts.title: Review a code change
prompts.description: Focus a review on correctness and regressions.
prompts.prompt: Review this change for correctness, regressions, and security: {{change}}. Report only actionable findings and cite affected files or lines.

prompts.title: Summarize local notes
prompts.description: Summarize provided notes without sharing them externally.
prompts.prompt: Summarize these notes locally and preserve their uncertainty: {{notes}}. Do not infer consent to share or transmit any content.
